question: Does Parpola 2019's H-942/H-2240/H-2241 obverse recurrence support H-2148's companion row or expose a sign-inventory problem?
result: Both. H-2240 exactly supports local +520-220-415+ as part of the companion-text family and H-2241 gives fragmentary 415 pressure, but H-942 is locally +520-220-016+ while Parpola names it in the same recurrence set. This makes H-942 a sign-inventory/source-normalization stress case, not a translation clue.
